Analyze the following external review that has been addressed.
Identify what our INTERNAL code review should have caught
BEFORE the external reviewer found it.

## External Review Feedback


## Code Comments (with Resolutions)
- [.github/workflows/build-images.yaml:117] **Missing `fetch-depth: 1` for upstream service checkout**

The upstream service checkout (e.g. `openstack/keystone`) is performed without `fetch-depth: 1`, so the full git history is fetched. OpenStack Keystone has been active since 2012 — its full history is hundreds of MB of objects. Fetching it on every CI run wastes time and runner disk space, and the extra history is never used: `git apply` works on the working tree regardless of depth, and the Dockerfile build context only needs the source files.

Adding `fetch-depth: 1` limits the checkout to the tip at the resolved ref:

```suggestion
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
        with:
          repository: openstack/${{ matrix.service }}
          ref: ${{ steps.source-ref.outputs.ref }}
          path: src/${{ matrix.service }}
          fetch-depth: 1
```

## Resolution Summary
The review feedback requested adding `fetch-depth: 1` to the upstream OpenStack service checkout step to avoid fetching the full git history on every CI run. This was addressed by adding `fetch-depth: 1` to the `actions/checkout` step for `openstack/${{ matrix.service }}` at line 118 of `.github/workflows/build-images.yaml`. No other files were modified to address this review comment.
